outcome: Land HMS Tireless: extend Zurcher inverse to free k (thermal conductivity) and c (specific heat) in addition to x_core j_0 T_oven_eff. 5-param fit with rho pinned at 1000 kg/m^3 (most product-stable). Test whether per-product physics calibration drops main-bake RMSE below the M9 Stefan baseline.
success_metric: 5-param joint inverse runs to convergence on 5+ of 7 real CSVs. Main-bake RMSE comparison vs Bellona (35-38 deg C), M9 Stefan (5-11 deg C), M7 baseline. Fitted k and c values land in literature ranges (k 0.2-0.5 W/m/K, c 1500-3000 J/kg/K) on most fixtures. If main-bake RMSE less than 3 deg C verdict GO and proceed to production wiring; if 3-6 deg C GO-WITH-CAVEATS; if greater than 6 deg C the information limit is confirmed across the full parameter-space exploration.
